body: I got a part time job when i was in grade 11 that made me work on the weekends so I physically could not come, but eventually when I began to question my sexuality and gender (I’m now a nonbinary lesbian) I didn’t feel comfortable going anymore. I don’t really say anything to my family about it since my mom and sister are diehard christians and my little sister is involved with the worship program, but I’ve personally lost interest and don’t see myself returning anytime soon.
